title: Point-automorphism transport commutes with completed coefficient extension
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite coefficient fields $E\subset L\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $g:s\to s$ be any scheme automorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $G_F=g^{-1}$ on completed $\mathcal O_F$-module complexes, with the coefficient action through $c_F^{-1}$, and $P_F=Lg_F^*$ for completed derived pullback [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], for $F=E,L$. For $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], put $T K=K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Write $\sigma^{g,F}$ for the restriction/coprojection maps of [lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural].

For a constructible complex $H$ put $C H=H\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L$, where $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $\chi_H:C H\to T H$ be the specified completion comparison [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $b_K:C G_E K\to G_L C K$ be the canonical inverse-image tensor comparison and let $\beta_K=G_L(\chi_K)b_K\chi_{G_EK}^{-1}:T G_E K\to G_L T K$ be exactly the comparison of [lem-weil-isomorphism-comparison-scalar-extension]. Let $\varphi_H:\Gamma(s,T H)\to\Gamma(s,H)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ be exactly the sections comparison of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], namely the inverse of sections-tensor followed by $\Gamma(s,\chi_H)$. All occurrences of $G_EK,P_EK$ here are constructible and derived complete [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback]. Put $\psi_K=\varphi_{G_EK}\Gamma(s,\beta_K)^{-1}$. Then
$$\psi_K\sigma^{g,L}_{TK}=(\sigma^{g,E}_K\otimes1)\varphi_K.$$

Let $\kappa^F_H:G_F H\to P_F H$ be the specified integral comparison [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and define $t^F_H=\Gamma(s,\kappa^F_H)\sigma^{g,F}_H$. For the canonical $\alpha_K:T(P_EK)\to P_L(TK)$ [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], one has
$$\varphi_{P_EK}\Gamma(s,\alpha_K)^{-1}t^L_{TK}=(t^E_K\otimes1)\varphi_K.$$
After tensoring this equation with $L$, it gives the same compatibility for $t^{E,\mathrm{rat}}_K=t^E_K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$ on the raw rationalized categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], under the rational sections and pullback scalar comparisons. These equations are compatible with identity and successive finite coefficient extensions under the canonical associators of the two cited scalar-comparison lemmas. No naturality of $t^F$ in $H$ is asserted here.
